The stay

Stunning, brand-new, and close to everything.

Villa Siesta is a brand-new three-bedroom, 2.5-bath home in Sunny Sarasota's downtown district — close to everything, yet tucked on a quiet street. Open floor plan, white cabinets, stainless appliances, a walk-in pantry, and a walkout to the patio and private swimming pool. Beach towels, chairs, and two bikes are yours to use.

Returning guests can reserve right here, straight with the owner: the same home you loved, without the extra service fees.
